text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I did it... I finished the race! I've<n>debuted!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Wahhh... Thank you! B-b...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big... Brother.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big... Sister.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Heh... hehe! I can't wait to see where<n>we go next!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With her debut officially complete,<n>Rice has taken
her first step forward.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: A few days later...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: We visit the racecourse again.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
In addition to getting an opportunity to<n>study the
other racers, spectating<n>other races will certainly be
a good<n>experience. However...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Wow... there are so many people. It's<n>like a G1
race...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Wait, I thought you said<n>today's race wasn't
even graded.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Here she is! Mihono Bourbon! What a<n>way to make
a debut!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
She closes the distance and takes the<n>lead! But she
doesn't stop there! She<n>keeps going, going,
goooiiing...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Aaand she's done it! Mihono<n>Bourbon crosses the
finish line in first<n>place!
Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Wow. The Classics are going to be<n>incredible next
year. I'm totally going<n>to root for Mihono Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Me too! She's sure to be the Triple<n>Crown
champion! We have to watch<n>all of her races.
...Everyone's smiling because of<n>Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: The cheers... are so much louder than<n>when I ran...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder if I can ever be like her.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Big Brother?!
Huh?! Big Sister?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hehe... Your voice is like a magic<n>spell.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hehe... Your voice is like a magic<n>spell.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: It's making me think... even I can do<n>the impossible.
choice_data_list: Do you want to run in the Classics too?
Do you want to run in the Classics too?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: The Classics...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Running in the Classics means facing<n>off against
the other racers who<n>debuted in the same year as
her.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It also means she'll have a chance to<n>go up against
Mihono Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Can I... really catch up to her? She<n>seems so far
away.
...You always believe in me, no matter<n>what.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...You always believe in me, no matter<n>what.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Okay. I'll do it.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm kind of scared... but I don't want<n>to be a
useless girl forever.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I... I'll do my best to catch up to<n>her—to Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And with that, Rice Shower and I<n>resolve to take on
the Classics.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But first, as a warm-up for the Triple<n>Crown tour,
we decide to take on the<n>Spring Stakes.
